name: Effective Range of Tagged Singletons
details: Every coordinate in the tagged-singletons domain is effective.
proof: For each ordinary coordinate $i\in[n]$, the tagged singleton containing $i$ differs from $\emptyset$ at $i$.  For each tag coordinate $n+\ell$, the singleton $\{n+\ell\}$ differs from $\emptyset$ there.  Hence the effective range is the full domain of $n+\lceil\log n\rceil$ coordinates.
